name: Word Search!
desc:
Play word search puzzles in Roblox!

Start a word search and find hundreds of different words on a grid! Beat puzzles to get exp and level up, and unlock more fun gamemodes to play! Work together with your friends to find words! Complete MILLIONS of different word search puzzles to level up and get on the leaderboard!

🧠 Relax and work with your mind as you complete puzzles. Word searches are a great way to ease yourself and get smarter! Relieve your stress as you enjoy the puzzle.

Have fun!
